      have h₁ : 0 ≤ x - 5 / 2 - r := by
        linarith
      have h₂ : 0 < x - 5 / 2 + r := by
        linarith
      have hp :
          0 ≤ (x - 5 / 2 + r) * (x - 5 / 2 - r) :=
        mul_nonneg h₂.le h₁
